name: Audio mixer solo
oneLiner: a glass mixing console of five channel strips: machined fader caps rise with a spring to their levels while the dB readouts follow, play is pressed and the LED meters bounce green to amber, then a cursor hits solo on the voice channel, it lights yellow with a halo, the other channels dim and drop silent and the voice rides alone into the master
say: when the speaker says they mix or clean up the audio or that the voice matters most ('I bring the music down under my voice', 'audio is half the video'): the faders rise while they set it up, solo lands on 'voice' or 'just me'
